decision.summary: No additional source item satisfies every Core promotion gate. Keep the frozen Core gap set at zero.

kitsCandidateReviews.reason: Core Camera already owns renderer-neutral smoothing and Third-Person Camera owns a concrete descriptor lifecycle. Prove a nonduplicate responsibility and a second renderer integration before proposing another atom.
Completion and exact-once ledgers already exist in Core. Perform API and invariant parity, then migrate or deprecate rather than add another state owner.

The behavior is renderer-neutral, deterministic, stateful, and atomic. Promotion still requires a second retained-world consumer, multi-renderer proof, and parity with existing Graphics batch descriptors.
The implementation remains body-plan-specific and lacks multiple product and renderer proofs. Universal descriptor fragments may later merge into Object or Actor after semantic extraction.
Compare against Object Shape jobs and qualified descriptors. Promote only a missing invariant, not a parallel procedural Object hierarchy.
Capture profiles are likely portable policy data over the existing Capture contract. Prove owned lifecycle state before treating them as an atom.
Object Fidelity already owns form packaging and selection. Add missing LOD invariants there after multi-consumer proof rather than create a second fidelity owner.
Renderer-neutral material descriptors already exist in Graphics. Keep authored material recipes external and merge only missing universal descriptor contracts.
Core World already owns cells, partitions, assembly, and patch preparation. Run bidirectional parity against those owners before retaining any missing scheduling invariant.

frozenNearGateReviews.reason: Domain composition and authored policy, not one universal atom.
Already represented by Core Composition discovery and dependency planning.
Already represented by Core Composition validation and planning.
Map descriptor invariants to existing Spatial and Object contracts.
A generic utility factory has no semantic state owner and is not a Core Domain.
Compose Pathfinding, Transport Route, Cargo, and Transfer Zone instead of adding an extraction atom.
ProtoKit compatibility is retired and cannot become current Core.
Concrete stereo rendering and runtime integration remain provider or Build target responsibilities.

externalRepositoryFollowUps: Pin NexusEngine-Kits development proof to the final committed Engine SHA.
Replace retired Core-prefixed migration imports with generated semantic subpaths.
Replace catalog write-back workflows with read-only generate-and-diff checks.
Reconcile the eleven overlapping placeholders without adding compatibility forwarding exports.
